robust_gaussian_surface — ROUGHNESS prepare op

• Data kinds: depth → depth

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.robust_gaussian_surface(z, dx, lambda_c, c=4.4, order=1, robust=True, truncate=1.0, dy=None, max_iter=None, tol=1e-06) (to call the implementation directly, import roughness; roughness.robust_gaussian_surface(z, dx, lambda_c, c=4.4, order=1, robust=True, truncate=1.0, dy=None, max_iter=None, tol=1e-06); from the registry, opsroughness.get("robust_gaussian_surface"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.robust_gaussian_surface(...) returns only the declared out type depth (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.robust_gaussian_surface.raw(...) or call roughness.robust_gaussian_surface directly.

• Underlying return: (roughness, mean_surface, info)

Usage

Robust Gaussian regression filter (surface): waviness and roughness of a surface that scratches and spikes cannot drag.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

robust_gaussian_profile の 2 次元版(核は x・y に可分、局所面 c + p u + q v の回帰、biweight は面全体の残差の中央値で作る)。重みが非可分でも、必要なのは重み画像と u^a v^b を掛けた核との可分相関だけなので、 O(N · 窓幅) で済む。

戻り値は (roughness, mean_surface, info)。端は削らず全面を返す。引数・fail-closed は断面版と同じ(dy=None は正方画素、z は 8x8 以上の 2 次元)。
